entities.name: Éric Trappier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Éric Trappier is a French businessman and engineer. Since January 2013, he has been the chief executive officer (CEO) of French aircraft manufacturer Dassault Aviation, a subsidiary of the Dassault Group. In 2025, Trappier became the chairman of Groupe Industriel Marcel Dassault, the Dassault family's holding company.
